searchText: Hi! My old (block, slot) branch is here: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/2197 The spec forkchoice operates on a simple block tree, so it's more like Prysm's linked tree than protoarray do anybody knows of any work being done on single-slot-finality? Last I've seen was the work of Francesco and Luca Zanolini https://eprint.iacr.org/2023/280 <@687974325072035882> during a slot when an attestor needs to attest to the chain head, do they need to receive the blob sidecars before they can perform the attestation process? Trying to understand how Deneb changed the attestation process when blobs got added in - when blobs are "p2p gossipped" to the other validators, is that essentially giving them the sidecars so that other validators can attest?
